set.body:
Supporting track: Run. Recurring until the pitch. Whoever runs the rehearsal reports to the owner.

Outcome
The plan is steered by what real use shows.

Each Friday
1. Run the four journeys on the current build on the real stack: the seeded instance until RUN2 is done, the pilot instance afterwards. A journey that is not built yet is recorded as not yet, with the item that is missing.
2. Record for each journey: passed, or the step that failed; the time taken; hesitations.
3. Each failure becomes a note on the owning item, or one new item tagged mvp with its journey. Nothing else enters the MVP.
4. Post a one-paragraph result as a note here. Compare it with the target dates in docs/plan.md and tell the owner when a date will slip.

The first rehearsal is Friday 20 November 2026. It is expected to fail most steps. That is the baseline.
set.title: RUN4: Friday rehearsal of all four journeys; log what breaks
